headline: Western Fronts Surge as Bases Flip Across Contested Zones
war_summary: Since the last edition six hours ago the western arc has intensified. Weathered Expanse now logs 41 ownership changes in the past day, up from 35, with the latest flip at 15:10 UTC. Fishermans Row has cooled to 34 flips from a reported 49, its most recent change at 08:53 UTC. Stlican Shelf climbed to 28 flips (from 21) and Deadlands holds at 15. Lykos Isle dropped to 12 flips from 19, while Godcrofts rose to 12 from 11. Callahans Passage remains steady at 11 flips, Marban Hollow at six, Tempest Island at six and Farranac Coast at five. Casualty streams tell a mixed story: Stonecradle’s losses have exploded to over 400 Colonial and 300 Warden casualties per hour, both accelerating sharply; Weathered Expanse, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor and Marban Hollow stay heavy but are cooling; Clahstra, Callahans Passage, Deadlands and Kings Cage show easing loss rates. Enlistment rates are rising in Godcrofts, Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse, hinting at fresh reinforcements. The deep Warden interior and the Colonial‑held south remain quiet with no base turnovers.
